name: Just-In-Time Access Request Assignment
description: Sent to the identity who made an access request that was automatically approved and assigned.
subject: Your access request for ${requestedObjectName} has been assigned
body:
Just-In-Time access assigned

Hello ${__recipient.name},

Your request for the ${requestedObjectName} entitlement has been assigned.

This entitlement requires activation before each use. To activate it, go to MySailPoint > Launchpad > Just-In-Time Access.

#if ($removeDate)

Your access to ${requestedObjectName} is scheduled to end on ${removeDate}.

#end

Best regards,
The ${__global.productName} Team
